about_the_game:
Timofey Pirozhkov, aka Timokha, is the main prankster on the planet! This time he flew straight from the Army and arranged an unforgettable vacation for tourists on the Maldives. Save the island from the prankster and his henchmen, otherwise he will show everyone his fat and delicious pie! Time is short, adventures are waiting for you! Dive into this amazing world as soon as possible! You will find not just a survival game in the style of fnaf, but something MORE!

GAME FEATURES:

-ALTERNATION OF DAY AND NIGHT

-VARIOUS QUESTS (SURFING ON A BOARD, UNDERWATER DIVING, NIGHT JUNGLE, PLANE BATTLE)

-NICE GRAPHICS

-HUMOR AND THE SEA... NO..... AN OCEAN OF JOKES ABOUT A DELICIOUS PIE! The game is a survival horror in the style of "point-and-click". You control the character from the first person by clicking the mouse. It is extremely important for you to correctly calculate your time, because one awkward movement and a scary screamer will not keep you waiting long! Also, quests with free movement await you!
